verses.en: When the LORD turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.
verses.pt: Quando o SENHOR restaurou Sião de seu infortúnio, estivemos como os que sonham.
verses.en_web: When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
verses.en_bbe: <A Song of the going up.> When the Lord made a change in Zion's fate, we were like men in a dream.

verses.en: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The LORD hath done great things for them.
verses.pt: Então nossa boca se encheu de riso, e nossa língua de alegria; então diziam entre as nações: O SENHOR fez grandes coisas para estes.
verses.en_web: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “Yahweh has done great things for them.”
verses.en_bbe: Then our mouths were full of laughing, and our tongues gave a glad cry; they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.

verses.en: The LORD hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.
verses.pt: Grandes coisas o SENHOR fez para nós; por isso estamos alegres.
verses.en_web: Yahweh has done great things for us, and we are glad.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has done great things for us; because of which we are glad.

verses.en: Turn again our captivity, O LORD, as the streams in the south.
verses.pt: Restaura-nos, ó SENHOR, como as correntes de águas no sul.
verses.en_web: Restore our fortunes again, Yahweh, like the streams in the Negev.
verses.en_bbe: Let our fate be changed, O Lord, like the streams in the South.

verses.en: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.
verses.pt: Os que semeiam em lágrimas colherão com alegria.
verses.en_web: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.
verses.en_bbe: Those who put in seed with weeping will get in the grain with cries of joy.

verses.en: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.
verses.pt: Aquele que sai chorando com semente para semear voltará com alegria, trazendo sua colheita. Cântico dos degraus, de Salomão:
verses.en_web: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.
verses.en_bbe: Though a man may go out weeping, taking his vessel of seed with him; he will come again in joy, with the corded stems of grain in his arms.
